reviews.x: I have tried Lume before and wasn't super into the dispenser (dotted top with the cream).  When a stick came out I decided to give it another whirl.  I have zero irritation and it's very comfortable.  I can swipe it on and dress and don't need to wait for it to dry or anything.  Peony is a nice floral scent that I like.  However, there are days when it seems like this gets me through 24 hours and I smell great..and days where I reek halfway through the day.  This was the same for the first time

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY SEVERE CHEMICAL BURN
reviews.x: Cannot believe this was recommended. Should have trusted the reviews. I have had the most serve chemical rash of my life that still hasn’t gone away. I used this stick maybe 6 times after 2/15 and STILL have the burns. They are taking forever to heal. Be super careful. I will say I still had BO with the stick but after much more time than with traditional deodorant but also my glands were quite possibly burned off lol so that might have something to do with smelling less.
I’m so so sorry, but this smells like moldy laundry on me. The product itself doesn’t smell. On me, it is not good. I know body chemistry can be different. Caution, TRY before you buy in bulk.

This stuff works I used it in between my panty lines and my thighs and under the Fupa and wow all day I smelled so fresh. I shower every day sometimes even when I get home from long day. This helps me stay fresh after a shower ALL DAY !

reviews.t: Like the scent but the original works better for me!
reviews.x: I’ll start by saying I’m giving it a 3 star as of today but if it changes I will come back and update.  So, I’ve been using Lume for years. I have the original deodorant with no scent(I’ve tried them all) anyhow…I HATE the smell of it but the smell does go away within hours and it does exactly what other deodorants don’t do and it’s all natural  BUT….  I decided to give the solid a try since the liquid always grosses me out and the smell is AWFUL(but it stops sweating and smells in its tracks) a
The minute I opened it, it smelled like MOLD!!

Scent wasn’t bad at all. It Worked well the first two days. About an hr after the third application my underarms began to itch. They turned red and irritated. I’ve used Lume cream with no problems. This is my first time using the solid and I will not buy again.
Saw this on Tiktok and so far I love it!! But it came cracked and is pushing up uneven now.

This product can cause chemical burns and rashes. It does last 3 days. I noticed it burned if I used it the same day that I shaved. After 6 months, I had chemical burns surrounding the arm pit area. I used in the bum area for about two months before developing a horrible rash. I had to get medical treatment for the rash.
This product had a awful smell to it, it was very course. Never again!!!

I’ve always struggled with finding the right deodorant.  I’ve tried prescription, natural, OTC, everything and nothing worked.  I tried this on a whim and I’m so glad I did.  I’m a week in and no rash like other brands, I apply before bed and I’m good for a couple of days.  It was 90 out today and I had no issues.  I normally work in an office all day, my job can be stressful and even after a big presentation, I was still fresh and dry.  I suggest everyone give this a try!

It smelled good but 3 to 5 hours after my shower, I smelled with bad body order from just working in the yard. Not only once but everytime I used it the same thing. I went back to my other Deodorant even if it does have Aluminum at least I no longer smell. It definitely did not last as long as they claim it should. Will not buy it again!

reviews.t: So disappointed in this product after hearing such good things..
reviews.x: It doesn't smell good, doesn't prevent sweat. As soon as I put it on I swear it makes me start sweating.. it is so expensive for a useless product.
No other way to explain but horrible smell... Save your money..

reviews.t: The solid stick sent me to the dermatologist
reviews.x: I am a huge fan of the original Lume cream deodorant and have been using it for about 3 years now. I also love their laundry spray for my husband’s gym clothes.  I was excited to try the solid stick, because the cream is a little inconvenient (it definitely works but has to be rubbed in)  I had a horrible skin reaction and had to go to the dermatologist. I am having to use a steroid cream to heal it up. It became very red, flaky, itchy, painful and burning in my underarms. I didn’t want to move

reviews.t: Why did I not know about this product sooner?
reviews.x: This stuff works. I stopped wearing deodorant during the pandemic but since we are all mingling again, it is a must. I wanted to stop using products with aluminum so tried this. I am confused by the reviews that say the smell is strong. I find the peony has a very light fragrance that I really like and the fragrance goes away after a few hours but stops BO even if I don't shower for 2 days (another habit that I picked up during COVID!!). I will be buying this again and will try different fragran

I already use Lume cream deodorant and had been hoping for a solid. The smell of Peony and Rose in the solid is nice, but unfortunately the odor blocking power is not strong in the solid. Maybe at most it worked for 6 hours? And I was only sitting at my desk.  With the cream I'm used to 72 hours of odor blocking (but the cream smells horrible upon application and fades after a minute.)  The solid is going in the trash and I already ordered another Lume cream.

Still up in the air with this one… i didn’t care for the smell with this one, and It didn’t last as long as expected, meaning freshness. The stick itself last I guess you can say… meaning it doesn’t run out as fast as a regular deodorant stick. However, I’ve used other sticks with non aluminum, and non all those other ingredients and it holds me all day, Dr.Teals in eucalyptus and for less the price!

reviews.t: Works great, the smell is not for me
reviews.x: Pluses: this works on all of the sweaty places and lasts for a full 12+ hour shift. The cream version is also great for keeping you fresh if you put it on straight out of the tub.  Minus: I hate the base scent. That's the problem with buying online, though, eh? Not very effective if you are trying to go every other day showering.  TLDR: works great, buying scent online is a mixed bag.

reviews.t: doesn't last as long as the others
reviews.x: I decided to try the solid stick because it was new and exciting. I feel like it doesn't last as long as the original type. It could just be the scent it comes in or maybe a different mix. it's a bit disapointing because I've tried all of the different scents from Lume and love them all, including this one, but this one doesn't seem to work as well.

I have tried many aluminum free deodorants and this one beats them all! Goes on nicely, smells amazing and truly does keep you smelling nice for up to 72 hours! I'm not a super sweaty or stinky person to begin with but other aluminum free deodorants I've used don't last the day, this can last several in my case!

I am SO disappointed with Lume Solid Deoderant "Peony Pink!" It smells just awful-as if it has spoiled! For a product that is supposed to be for personal deoderizing, the smell of "Peony Pink" is far worse than any body odor. I don't know if the Lot #1328A, has gone bad, or just the container I received.

I'm in my mid 40s with bouts of sweating.  Nothing seemed to even begin to cover it up.  If used as directed it really does work!  I dont even have to reapply for up to 48 hours.  Recommended for mid life women & definitely reccomend the lotion deodorant also.  This new scent is great!

It only lasted a few hours before I needed a shower again. I’m glad I was at home and not out and about. For it to cost as much as it does, I thought it would’ve worked. I’ll stick to my natural deodorant called Thai that I got from Whole Foods for half the price.

reviews.t: I do it a little different
reviews.x: I have tried several Lume deodorants, and today I will buy the Peony. I sweat so much and I am postmenopausal. I spray some magnesium spray under my arms first, let it dry, then use the deodorant and let it dry. It works that way for me.

claims.text: Several reviewers report severe skin irritation, rashes, or chemical burns from the solid stick.
Many reviewers complain the product has an unpleasant or moldy smell.
Some reviewers say it does not control odor or sweat effectively.
Other reviewers praise it for keeping them fresh all day and working where other deodorants failed.
A few reviewers find it comfortable to apply with no irritation, though one received a cracked stick.
